mentions.name: Zoupyu
mentions.description: This tool lets users paste a long video, uses AI to suggest the best moments, and lets them pick the start and end points to turn those moments into clips, giving full manual control over each second. It aims to expand into a platform that brings creators and clippers together through content rewards.
mentions.problem: Most AI clippers just pick the moments for you, leaving no control over the output.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Zoupyu (https://zoupyu.com). You paste a long video, it suggests the best moments, and you pick the start and end points which then become clips.
